rubrics.justification: Accurately describes a hatching/expanded blastocyst consistent with 4BA, with appropriate comments on loosely grouped ICM and cohesive TE. Minor overreach includes specific claims about small spherical structures and some image details not clearly verifiable from a single static image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, oocyte yield, prior cycle outcome, semen parameters, BMI, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, and the probability estimate is logically derived. Minor issues include somewhat speculative adjustments and overinterpretation of the DOR label/POSEIDON grouping from limited data.

Mostly evidence-based and aligned on SET and general embryo assessment, but includes recommendations with weaker guideline support after limited failure history (e.g., ERA, thrombophilia/immunologic workup, routine progesterone monitoring/additional estradiol suggestions).

Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer management and future cycle planning, including protocol reconsideration and further evaluation pathways. Slightly reduced by inclusion of some lower-yield or premature investigations.
